summary: Prototype guest admission and catalog rules have strict ownership, administrator decisions and immutable revisions; inherited broad academic teacher permissions still require a separate least-privilege migration before broader onboarding.

findings.issue: Administrator-admitted teachers inherit existing trusted academic staff access across legacy modules; analytics section assignments do not constrain every academic collection.
findings.recommendation: Review trusted-teacher onboarding and design consistent tenant/section ACLs and compatible queries before opening access to unrelated teachers or schools.

findings.issue: Directory and catalog discovery are bounded but do not yet paginate all older requests and catalogs.
findings.recommendation: Add cursor pagination before the configured bounds are reached.
